**Thanksgiving** is a [federal holiday in the United States](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federal_holidays_in_the_United_States) celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November (which became the uniform date country-wide in 1941). The earliest Thanksgiving can occur is November 22; the latest is November 28.

## History
### The Revolutionary War Era to the Civil War
[Caleb Strong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caleb_Strong), Governor of the Commonwealth of [Massachusetts](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massachusetts), declared the holiday in 1813, "for a day of public thanksgiving and prayer" for Thursday, November 25 of that year.

## Date
Since being fixed on the fourth Thursday in November by law in 1941 (from 1863 to 1940 it was on the last Thursday in November),[[72]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thanksgiving_(United_States)#cite_note-5USC87b-73) the holiday in the United States can occur on any date from November 22 to 28 (November 24 to 30 from 1863 to 1940). Regardless, it is the Thursday preceding the last Saturday of November.
